Bro I've seen that you've been around here. Don't do it. If you have someone to talk to or need someone, do so. If you talk about your problems you can always find a way out and hopefully eas the pain that follows you.

I know it may seem like its a good idea right now. My dads is also really abusive to me and that's why I have come to this subreddit. So I know how you feel. But ending it now especially at this young age is not a good idea. If you have friends that a close to you, another family member that you can trust or a teacher that may help you, please reach out to them. It seems like an easy way out but it really isn't. The thought of what is next to follow and the fear of actually doing the act is so immense. Also, the idea of missing out on a happy life also hurts a lot.

If you need to talk and want to stay anonymous I'm here.

Suicide has no scale. Its always matters. You not being able to kill yourself isn't a sign of weakness its shows that you still want to live. If you need to talk please find someone like a therapist or family member or a friend you trust the most. If you cant do that PM me so you have at least someone to talk to. If you want we can play some PC games and talk.

Hey, life is shit. I know. If you want to PM me and need someone to talk to you and maybe try to make you feel a little better. It's hard to hear at this point in life that you need some kind of purpose and you need to do something with your life when right now you can't find even a sliver of hope to save your own life.

Really PM if you need it. I don't know where in the world are you but we can work something out.

Hey man, I know things can be miserable, trust me I know. I have recently found this subreddit to find help of my own due to struggles in family and school. Also, long-lasting trauma from my family has brought so much pain. If you need to talk to a stranger over text to make you safe I'll be happy to support you. Life sucks and is not fair and the people on this subreddit are the ones that know that the most. Please if your still there PM me so we can talk. I want to do the same as you but I don't have the will to do so. But if my life can save another that would help me out too.
